bundle.longDescription: Citrate Quorum — a governed workspace where humans in control (HIC) and AI agents hold auditable meetings, run the Agentile loop, and deploy plain-English governance protocols as smart contracts on Citrate. Every agent action is policy-gated, signed through a human ceremony where required, recorded, and anchored on chain.
